#flags: Descriptions for HDLForge native command options.

flags.#--jobs: Maximum parallel jobs passed to Vivado (default 1).
flags.#--follow: Refresh process identity and log status every two seconds.
flags.#--run: Run name passed directly to Vivado; Vivado handles dependencies and rejection.
flags.#--property: Select one property of the specified saved run.
flags.#--summary: Show saved run status grouped by synthesis parent without contacting Vivado.
flags.#--json: Print machine-readable run inventory or saved values.
flags.#--tool: Tool to execute: vivado, Verilator, network, vcd_analyzer, tsharkWrapper, hw_server, or projects (required)
flags.#--flags: Additional Verilator flags; may be repeated
flags.#--file: Project-relative Verilator source file(s) for dependency-aware lint
flags.#--lint-file: Project-relative Verilator source file(s) for raw selected-file lint
flags.#--generate_prj_with_external_tcl: Generate Vivado project using external TCL script
flags.#--file_remove: Remove a file from the Vivado project
flags.#--file_add: Add a file to the Vivado project
flags.#--file_path: File path (required for file_remove and file_add)
flags.#--add_file_to_project_tcl: Add file sections to the exported Vivado project Tcl
flags.#--remove_file_from_project_tcl: Remove file sections from the exported Vivado project Tcl
flags.#--remove_file_fom_project_tcl: Remove file sections from the exported Vivado project Tcl
flags.#--add_run_to_project_tcl: Add synth/implementation run sections to the exported Vivado project Tcl
flags.#--add_rrun_to_project_tcl: Add synth/implementation run sections to the exported Vivado project Tcl
flags.#--add_run_fom_project_tcl: Add synth/implementation run sections to the exported Vivado project Tcl
flags.#--add_rrun_fom_project_tcl: Add synth/implementation run sections to the exported Vivado project Tcl
flags.#--remove_run_from_project_tcl: Remove synth/implementation run sections from the exported Vivado project Tcl
flags.#--remove_rrun_fom_project_tcl: Remove synth/implementation run sections from the exported Vivado project Tcl
flags.#--remove_run_fom_project_tcl: Remove synth/implementation run sections from the exported Vivado project Tcl
flags.#--project_tcl_json: Inline JSON dictionary for project Tcl edits
flags.#--project_tcl_json_file: JSON file for project Tcl edits
flags.#--clean_logs: Clean Vivado log files from current directory
flags.#-f: Skip confirmation prompts for the selected operation.
flags.#--force: Skip confirmation prompts for the selected operation.
flags.#--cmd: Execute a shell command, or select the chosen native tool's command.
flags.#--eth_dst_mac: Ethernet destination MAC address (default: FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF for requests)
flags.#--get_modules_list: List all modules in the design
flags.#--get_values_pins: Module path to list value changes for pins only (excludes sub-modules)
flags.#--get_values_all: Module path to list value changes for all signals (excludes sub-modules)
flags.#--human: Human-readable output format with padding (for --get_values_pins or --get_values_all)
flags.#--frame_list: Comma-separated list of frame numbers to display
flags.#--count: Number of packets to display (use with --skip for pagination)
flags.#--skip: Skip this many packets before displaying
flags.#--tsharkArgsAppend: Additional raw tshark arguments to append
flags.#--disable_protocols: Comma-separated list of protocols to disable (e.g., mndp,ssdp)
flags.#-c: Config JSON file for hw_server (auto-detected from invoke location if not provided)
flags.#--hw-config: Config JSON file for hw_server (auto-detected from invoke location if not provided)
flags.#--config-file: Config JSON file for hw_server (auto-detected from invoke location if not provided)
flags.#-i: Interactive mode for hw_server (keep console open)
flags.#--interactive: Interactive mode for hw_server (keep console open)
flags.#-ic: Run commands then exit for hw_server (e.g., -ic 2 i1)
flags.#--interactive-chain: Run commands then exit for hw_server (e.g., -ic 2 i1)
flags.#-d: Enable debug output showing TCL commands and inputs
flags.#--debug: Enable debug output showing TCL commands and inputs
flags.#--list: List all available projects recursively from current directory
flags.#--raw: Print Tcl output without table formatting
flags.#--output: Override the write_tcl destination; default is the project's configured Tcl
flags.#--timeout: Maximum seconds to wait for the console or command lock (default: 180)
flags.#--json-file: Existing JSON file for install-json; update-json detects its own selected file
flags.#--key: Dotted parent key for installation, e.g. LLM_orch.vivado; replace its project_console group entirely
flags.#--project-json: HDLForge project selected by the native --project option
flags.#--overwrite: Allow install-json to replace an existing project_console group; update-json always replaces it
flags.#--get_xpr_path: Print the absolute configured XPR path without starting Vivado; works before project creation.
flags.#--project_console: Manage the persistent Vivado console; select an action. Use help for options.
flags.#--project_mng: Manage project files, consoles, live runs, and saved runs. Select an action; use help for options.
flags.#--eval_json: Execute a command from the selected project's JSON key.
flags.#--append: Append arguments to the selected project shortcut or shell command.
flags.#--dry-run: Resolve the command and environment without executing the final command.
flags.#--env-python: Add Python paths from a JSON array or project JSON key.
flags.#--env-path: Add executable search paths from a JSON array or project JSON key.
flags.#--env-var: Export environment variables from a JSON array or project JSON key.
flags.#--group: Synthesis group from get_groups; process synthesis and enabled implementations.
flags.#--reset: With build_run/build_group, reset the target before its full build.
flags.#--submission: Submission ID for status or stop; status defaults to all submissions.
flags.#--quiet-seconds: Label a live process Quiet after this many seconds without log output (default 60).
flags.#--lines: Number of trailing log lines to display (default 8).
flags.#--no-bitstream: Stop implementation at route_design instead of write_bitstream.
flags.#--monitor: Monitor runs: status, timing-graph, tail, collection, and management. Use help for all actions.

#values: Descriptions for native tool and command choices.

values.#vivado: Create, inspect, and build Vivado projects; manage consoles and run databases.
values.#Verilator: Build, run, or lint HDL simulations using Verilator.
values.#network: Send raw Ethernet, ARP, ICMP, or UDP packets.
values.#vcd_analyzer: Inspect modules and signal transitions in VCD waveform files.
values.#tsharkWrapper: Decode and filter packets from capture files with tshark.
values.#hw_server: Program and inspect FPGA hardware through Vivado hardware server.
values.#lint: Lint the selected HDL sources or simulation target.
values.#send_arp: Send an ARP request or response.
values.#program: Program the selected FPGA bitstream and probes.
values.#scan_jtag: Scan devices on the JTAG chain.
values.#read_dna: Read the FPGA device DNA identifier.
values.#to_plain_text: Render decoded packets as plain text.

#project_console: Reusable native Vivado project management actions and their shortcut names.

project_console.#status: Show whether the console is open and which project it holds.
project_console.#close: Terminate the managed console even when Tcl is stuck; clear its pending request marker. Interrupts any Tcl command running in that console.
project_console.#restart: Close the managed console if open, clear pending requests, and start a fresh console with this XPR. Also starts it when closed.
project_console.#send: Execute Tcl in the project console. Append --cmd, for example: --append '--cmd "get_ips"'.
project_console.#runs: List run names from the saved XPR without opening Vivado.
project_console.#export_open_project_to_tcl: Overwrite the configured project Tcl with the open project's settings. Append --output PATH to export elsewhere.
project_console.#generate_project_from_tcl: Generate the project using the checked-in Tcl and its force option. Close the managed console first; existing-project handling follows the Tcl.
project_console.#clean: Close the managed console and delete this project's generated folder, including its XPR, IP, and run results. Keep the project JSON and Tcl.
project_console.#clean_logs: Remove supported Vivado logs from the current directory; keep project files and run results.
project_console.#list: List managed Vivado console sessions without opening a project.
project_console.#name: Show this project's canonical XPR path and console session name without opening it.
project_console.name: name
project_console.#capture: Show recent terminal output from this project's existing console.
project_console.#help: Show console actions and options, including --json-file FILE, --key PARENT, and --overwrite for JSON installation/update.
project_console.#print-hdlforge-json-commends: Print the self-contained project_console JSON fragment. To insert it, use install-json with --json-file FILE --key PARENT.
project_console.#install-json: Insert project_console under a JSON parent. Append '--json-file FILE --key LLM_orch.vivado'. Warn and leave an existing group unchanged unless --overwrite is appended; overwrite replaces the entire group.
project_console.#update-json: Detect this shortcut's own JSON file and parent key, then replace its complete project_console group by default. No --overwrite flag, base commands, or other JSON groups are required. Sibling groups stay intact.
project_console.#get_runs: List saved XPR runs, parents, strategies, and enabled state without opening Vivado. Append --json. Use vivado.monitor.status for live progress.
project_console.#get_groups: List synthesis groups, availability, and implementation children from the saved XPR without opening Vivado. Append --json.
project_console.#build_run: Submit one run directly to a separate Vivado batch. Append --run NAME; optional --reset, --jobs N, --no-bitstream.
project_console.#reset_run: Reset one synthesis or implementation run without launching; synthesis reset invalidates all its children. Append '--run NAME'. Use get_build_options for complete copy-paste commands.
project_console.#enable_run: Enable one synthesis or implementation run in the XPR; enabling a group preserves individual child exclusions. Append '--run NAME'. Use get_build_options for complete copy-paste commands.
project_console.#disable_run: Disable one synthesis or implementation run in the XPR; active runs finish, later launches are skipped. Append '--run NAME'. Use get_build_options for complete copy-paste commands.
project_console.#build_group: Submit a synthesis group and enabled implementations in a separate Vivado batch. Append --group NAME; optional --reset.
project_console.#reset_group: Reset a synthesis group and its enabled implementations without launching; synthesis reset invalidates all its children. Append '--group NAME'. Use get_build_options for complete copy-paste commands.
project_console.#enable_group: Enable a synthesis group and its enabled implementations in the XPR; enabling a group preserves individual child exclusions. Append '--group NAME'. Use get_build_options for complete copy-paste commands.
project_console.#disable_group: Disable a synthesis group and its enabled implementations in the XPR; active runs finish, later launches are skipped. Append '--group NAME'. Use get_build_options for complete copy-paste commands.
project_console.#get_build_options: Read saved XPR configuration without opening Vivado and print Group, Command, Arguments, and Explanation columns. Show each command once per group with argument variations below it. Combine the command with an Arguments cell to execute; quoting is preserved. Run from this project directory. Append --json for complete structured options.

monitor.#tail: Follow one runme.log by run name. Append --run NAME; optional --lines 50 or --no-follow for a snapshot. Ctrl-C stops only the log view.
monitor.#timing-graph: List available runs, saved status, sample counts, logs, and graph commands when called without arguments. Append --run NAME or --file timing_progress.json to plot timing; optional --metric wns and --kind completed.
monitor.#clear: Clear saved monitor records for all runs, or append a run name. Build files are kept; runs are rediscovered on the next scan.
monitor.#collect: Analyze and accumulate artifacts for one confirmed closed run. Append --run NAME; preserves earlier evidence.
monitor.#follow: Continuously display the latest saved status table. Does not launch builds or perform scans.
monitor.#help: Show monitor commands and their arguments.
monitor.#help-slack: Show Slack token setup and interactive status-menu instructions.
monitor.#help-verbose: Show the full monitor guide: discovery, PID checks, stale status, remote execution, and collection.
monitor.#restart: Restart only the monitor and reload configuration. Vivado builds continue untouched.
monitor.#scan: Discover all runs from the targeted HDLForge JSON, check logs/PIDs, update status, and dispatch lifecycle tasks.
monitor.#start: Start one background monitor for the targeted HDLForge JSON. Logs/state go beside it under _vivado_monitor/<JSON filename>/; repeated starts reuse it.
monitor.#status: Display the last saved run-status table without scanning. Use scan to refresh it now.
monitor.#stop: Stop only the monitor daemon. Does not stop Vivado builds or collection workers already launched.
monitor.#print-hdlforge-json-commands: Print the reusable monitor shortcut JSON with descriptions; does not modify files.
monitor.#install-json: Install monitor shortcuts into an existing JSON file. Append --json-file FILE --key PARENT; --overwrite replaces an existing monitor group.
monitor.#update-json: Refresh this monitor shortcut group and its descriptions in the targeted HDLForge JSON, preserving existing vivado.monitor settings and sibling configuration.
monitor.#performance: List collected stage performance files and arguments. Append --files FILE [FILE ...] to compare; --metric elapsed_seconds|cpu_seconds|peak_memory_mb|wns_ns|tns_ns|whs_ns|ths_ns, --stage TEXT, --graph.
